name: Real estate developers and agents
description: For developers and agents selling homes and land, including to buyers living abroad.

intake.label: Current projects or listings
intake.help: One per line, with location. For example: Palm Grove Phase 2, east side

intake.label: Unit types and prices
intake.help: Prices in {currency}. Add a second currency if you sell to buyers abroad.

intake.label: Title documents available
intake.help: For example, in Nigeria: C of O, Governor's Consent, Registered Survey. Elsewhere: freehold, leasehold, title deed.

intake.label: Payment plans
intake.help: Deposit and how long buyers have to pay.

intake.label: How inspections work
intake.help: Physical days and times, and whether you offer virtual video inspections.

qualifiers: What budget are you working with?
Which country do you live in at the moment?
Is this to live in, rent out, or hold as an investment?
When are you hoping to buy?
Would you pay outright or prefer a payment plan?

steps.message: Hi {firstName}, just checking in from {businessName}. Would you like the brochure and title documents for the project you asked about?
Hi {firstName}, we still have units available on flexible payment plans. Would a quick video inspection this week help you decide?
Hi {firstName}, this is a last check in from {businessName}. Reply any time and we will pick up where we left off.
Hi {firstName}, a reminder of your inspection with {businessName} on {bookingTime}. Reply here if you need to change it.
Hi {firstName}, your inspection with {businessName} is at {bookingTime}. See you soon.
Hi {firstName}, thank you for choosing {businessName}. If you were happy with us, a short review would help other buyers trust us.

adTemplates.audience: Nigerians living in the UK, US and Canada interested in property in Nigeria
adTemplates.angle: Verified title and virtual inspection before you fly in
Flexible payment plan with a fixed price

compliance: Never promise guaranteed returns or fixed resale profits.
Only state title documents the business has confirmed.
Meta treats housing ads as a special category with limited targeting.
conversionPrompt: Would you like to book an inspection? We can do a video call or a visit to the site. Tell me a day and time that suits you.
